metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the rotten post, two Lent mornings for the carpenter, and Egeon at two.

yesterday: The post on the north side took the knife two inches. It was laid in 1576. The ground falls back to Giles Allen on the thirteenth of April, 1597.
You promised two mornings in March to the carpenter. You left the law with the family.
You opened The Comedy of Errors and were idle until the end. The margin says not to hurry the loss of the wife.
At supper you reported a damp post. The writing day tomorrow is at the lodging.
